comparison.objective: Hold a ruler against paper and draw a straight line of at least 12 cm along its near edge.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilize a guide while moving a marker in continuous edge contact; no impact, fracture, or fragment search is involved.
comparison.success_condition: A straight line at least 12 cm long, marker tip against the ruler edge, followed by lifting the marker; the record reports demo 1.0 and Dream-1 0.0.
comparison.reason: It shares bimanual tool stabilization only as a generic primitive; continuous guided marking tests a different ability and outcome.
